title: Python Syntax Overview
overview: Python syntax defines the rules for writing Python programs. Python uses simple and readable syntax compared to many other programming languages.

title: Python Indentation
overview: Python uses indentation instead of curly brackets to define code blocks. Proper spacing is required for Python programs to run correctly.

title: Python Comments
overview: Comments are used to explain code and are ignored by the Python interpreter. They help developers understand programs better.

title: Python Print Function
overview: The print function is used to display output on the screen. It is one of the most commonly used Python functions.

title: Python Input Function
overview: The input function allows users to enter values while the program is running. It always returns data as a string.

title: Python Statements
overview: Statements are instructions executed by Python. Each line of Python code usually represents a statement.

title: Python Multiple Statements
overview: Python allows multiple statements to be written in a program. Usually, each statement is written on a separate line for readability.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned Python syntax basics including indentation, comments, print, input, and writing Python statements.
